coverage: Seven current provinces, including Koshi and Madhesh, and all 77 districts. Official NSO 2021 census populations sum to 29,164,578. HDX Survey Department / UNRCO 2024 boundary reference. The 775-feature source third level mixes local governments and protected areas, so that ambiguous level is not exposed. No translated subdivision names are inferred from the English-only source. Shared display edges use the existing atlas India and China geometry; the western junction has a documented source alignment adjustment. Competing territorial claims are not determined by this reference map.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
